fields.description: What this slot is, in plain words: "Hero headline", "Second photo band, caption". Shown beside the pencil when somebody edits the page, so it is the label an administrator navigates by.
fields.label: Label

fields.description: The stable business key, and the docname. A component in the frontend asks for exactly this key, so renaming the label above never blanks a page. Keys read as a path, for instance landing.hero.headline.
fields.label: Content Key

fields.description: Which screen this block belongs to. The frontend loads one surface in one request, and a surface's Readable By Guests setting decides whether a signed-out visitor sees it.
fields.label: Surface

fields.description: Ordering for the desk list only, so the blocks of a page read top to bottom the way the page does. Layout is the frontend's business; changing this moves nothing on the page.
fields.label: Sequence

fields.description: The words shown in this slot. Plain text, deliberately: it is rendered as text rather than as markup, so an administrator editing a heading can never inject a script into a page served to the public. Line breaks are kept.
fields.label: Text

fields.description: Where this slot links to, if it links anywhere. A path within the site, or an http, https, mailto or tel address. Anything else is refused on save, because a link a visitor clicks is a link this app served them.
fields.label: Link

fields.description: The picture shown in this slot. Left empty, the page draws its own placeholder rather than a broken image, so a society that has uploaded nothing still has a page that looks finished.
fields.label: Image

fields.description: What the picture shows, for somebody using a screen reader and for the case where the image does not load. Worth writing: a decorative photo may leave it empty, a photo carrying meaning may not.
fields.label: Alt Text

fields.description: Who took the picture and under what licence, shown as a small caption over the image. Empty means no caption is drawn.
fields.label: Photo Credit

fields.description: Guidance for whoever edits this next: how long the text should be, what the picture needs to show. Never displayed to a visitor.
fields.label: Editor Notes
